[!symlink] skip 'fake GOROOT needs symlinks'
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOWORK=off
env CGO_ENABLED=0

# Overlays replace the effective toolchain tree: an inserted .lgo file in a
# GOROOT logos/* package must be copied from its lowered output, and a
# deleted file must not be requested from staging. The test installs fixture
# packages in a private toolchain root inside $WORK and selects it with
# GOROOT. Nothing is written into the real GOROOT.
go run mkgoroot.go $TESTGO_GOROOT $WORK/fakegoroot dep
go run mkovl.go $WORK/fakegoroot $WORK/ovl
env GOROOT=$WORK/fakegoroot

cd m

# Without the overlay the program is broken: Extra only exists in it.
! logos run .
logos run -overlay=$WORK/ovl/overlay.json .
stdout '^ovl base plus ovl extra$'

logos build -overlay=$WORK/ovl/overlay.json --emit-go=out .
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestovl/extra.go
! exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestovl/removed.go
grep '^inserted header$' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestovl/inserted.h
grep '^replacement header$' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestovl/replaced.h

env GOROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
cd out
go build -mod=readonly ./...
go run .
stdout '^ovl base plus ovl extra$'

-- mkgoroot.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"
)

func must(err error, what string) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "mkgoroot: %s: %v\n", what, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func link(oldname, newname string) {
	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(newname), 0777), "mkdir "+filepath.Dir(newname))
	must(os.Symlink(oldname, newname), "symlink "+newname)
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 4 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: mkgoroot <realGOROOT> <fakeRoot> <fixtures>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	real, fake, fixtures := os.Args[1], os.Args[2], os.Args[3]

	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), 0777), "mkdir fake src/logos")

	ents, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(real, "src"))
	must(err, "read real src")
	for _, e := range ents {
		if e.Name() == "logos" {
			continue
		}
		link(filepath.Join(real, "src", e.Name()), filepath.Join(fake, "src", e.Name()))
	}

	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(filepath.Join(real, "src", "logos"))), "copy support sources")
	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(fixtures)), "install fixture packages")

	// The package index distinguishes .lgo-only standard packages, but
	// bypasses files with recent mtimes. Age only the private copies.
	old := time.Now().Add(-time.Hour)
	must(filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), func(name string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil || !d.Type().IsRegular() {
			return err
		}
		return os.Chtimes(name, old, old)
	}), "age copied support and fixture files")

	link(filepath.Join(real, "pkg"), filepath.Join(fake, "pkg"))
	link(filepath.Join(real, "VERSION"), filepath.Join(fake, "VERSION"))
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "go.env")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "go.env"), filepath.Join(fake, "go.env"))
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "lib")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "lib"), filepath.Join(fake, "lib"))
	}
}
-- mkovl.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

func quote(s string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteByte('"')
	for _, r := range s {
		switch r {
		case '\\', '"':
			b.WriteByte('\\')
			b.WriteRune(r)
		default:
			b.WriteRune(r)
		}
	}
	b.WriteByte('"')
	return b.String()
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 3 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: mkovl <fakeGOROOT> <outdir>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	fake, out := os.Args[1], os.Args[2]
	if err := os.MkdirAll(out, 0777); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "mkovl: mkdir %s: %v\n", out, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	extra := "package ejecttestovl\n\nfunc Extra() string { return \"ovl extra\" }\n"
	extraPath := filepath.Join(out, "extra.lgo")
	if err := os.WriteFile(extraPath, []byte(extra), 0666); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "mkovl: write %s: %v\n", extraPath, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	// Age the replacement like mkgoroot ages the private tree, so the
	// package index sees the effective file instead of bypassing it.
	old := time.Now().Add(-2 * time.Hour)
	if err := os.Chtimes(extraPath, old, old); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "mkovl: chtimes %s: %v\n", extraPath, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	for name, content := range map[string]string{
		"inserted.h": "inserted header\n",
		"replaced.h": "replacement header\n",
	} {
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, name), []byte(content), 0666); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "mkovl: write %s: %v\n", name, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}
	removed := filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos", "ejecttestovl", "removed.lgo")
	inserted := filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos", "ejecttestovl", "extra.lgo")
	doc := "{\n\"Replace\": {\n" +
		quote(removed) + ": \"\",\n" +
		quote(inserted) + ": " + quote(extraPath) + ",\n" +
		quote(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos", "ejecttestovl", "inserted.h")) + ": " + quote(filepath.Join(out, "inserted.h")) + ",\n" +
		quote(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos", "ejecttestovl", "replaced.h")) + ": " + quote(filepath.Join(out, "replaced.h")) + "\n}\n}\n"
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "overlay.json"), []byte(doc), 0666); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "mkovl: write overlay.json: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
-- dep/ejecttestovl/base.lgo --
package ejecttestovl

func Base() string { return "ovl base" }

-- dep/ejecttestovl/removed.lgo --
package ejecttestovl

func Removed() string { return missing() }

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ovltoolchain

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/ejecttestovl"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(ejecttestovl.Base() + " plus " + ejecttestovl.Extra())
}

-- dep/ejecttestovl/replaced.h --
physical header
